_doc: Step 10. Threshold → sentence rules. Each rule fires when a dimension crosses its threshold. The engine emits all matching lines plus the dominant-theme summary. Lines marked _spec are from the specification.

rules.text: The emotional system is highly active today. Reactions may be stronger than usual.
External demands may feel heavier. Prioritise structure and pacing.
A good day for leadership, decisions and visibility.
Avoid making major emotional judgments based solely on today's perceptions.
Relationships and emotional validation may occupy a larger share of mental bandwidth.
Drive is high — a good day to start or push forward on what matters.
Patience is thin today; give yourself extra margin before reacting.
Impulses run strong — pause before committing to anything irreversible.
Connection feels easy today — lean into people and conversation.
A more inward day; solitude may feel more natural than company.
Concentration is sharp — protect a block of deep work.
An unusually calm baseline today — good for rest and recovery.

chandra_ashtama_line: This is a Chandra Ashtama day (the Moon is in the 8th from your natal Moon). Energy may dip; keep the day light and avoid major decisions.
